sisi.depan: A vast, inactive wall screen made of a single sheet of polished dark crystal dominates the front wall from floor to ceiling.
sisi.kanan: Towering shelves of cold, grey industrial metal are filled with identical, featureless metallic data-cubes.
sisi.belakang: A wide, sound-dampening sliding panel door of brushed metal is set into the back wall.
sisi.kiri: The bare left wall is a uniform surface of flat grey composite, broken only by a narrow ventilation grille near the floor.

tengah: A large, monolithic desk, formed from a single block of dark, non-reflective synthetic material, faces the front wall.
atas: The ceiling consists of an exposed structural grid of dark metal beams, with recessed strips emitting a cold, flat light.
